column1: #   "Parking structures and gated lots are operational 24/7."
#   "Parking rates apply Monday-Saturday, while parking is free on Sunday
#   "Metered parking on-street and in lots is enforced Monday-Saturday 8:00am-6:00pm."
# Kind: structure = gated, verified rules (rates Mon-Sat, free Sun 4am-Mon 4am)
#       lot       = surface lot; DDA does not publish per-lot gated-vs-metered
#                   status, so these are marked confidence=assumed and are NOT
#                   reported as free. Conservative (structure-like) window applied.
# Capacity is as published by DDA; some values are visibly stale (Maynard 150,
# Fourth and Washington 0) so capacity is advisory only, never used for free/paid.
